x1.desc: a crowd of grey, tan and dark red penguin spectators seen from behind

s1.desc: a home with a long curved teal counter, drawn on a plain pale grey background

s2.desc: a prize ceremony with a pale three-step winner's podium, drawn on a plain pale grey background

spans.notes: Pax on a plain background shaking open a black trash bag; 20 frames

spans.view: with an open cabinet door in the counter and a bin inside it

beats.text: Pax, seen from behind, fits a black trash bag into the bin inside the open cabinet
Pax turns around to face forward with his eyes closed in a satisfied smile as sparkles pop over the bin
Pax stands beside the sparkling bin with his flippers together, looking ahead

spans.notes: exactly 21 frames; compare 20/40 and the global-motion estimate both show the counter locked (identity) until f40; the pull-back starts at f41
fast pull-back from Pax at the cabinet to the wide view revealing Polly in the archway (scale about 0.97 -> 0.90 per frame)

spans.view: with a tall arched doorway on the left and the counter with its open cabinet on the right

beats.text: Polly stands in the archway holding a basket of laundry and squints toward Pax while Pax stands quietly beside the sparkling bin
Polly turns to the front and throws her flippers up, dropping the basket so the laundry spills on the floor
Polly stands frozen with her beak open and her flippers raised while Pax stays by the cabinet

spans.notes: compare 51/88: arch and counter edges black; global estimate 51->88 identity. f50->f51 is the last frame of the pull-back

spans.view: with the bin sparkling inside the open cabinet beside him

beats.text: Pax stands beside the sparkling bin looking ahead with wide eyes, then closes them in a smile
Pax turns his head to the left and glances sideways with blushing cheeks, his flippers folded in front of him
Pax squeezes his eyes shut in a bashful, blushing smile, swaying gently

spans.view: with the edge of an arched doorway behind her and a tipped-over laundry basket on the floor

beats.text: Polly stands frozen with her flippers raised beside her cheeks, staring wide-eyed with tears streaming down
Polly squeezes her eyes shut and cries with her beak open, pressing her flippers to her chest and cheek and rocking on her feet

spans.notes: compare 121/150: arch and basket edges black | verification pass 2 (verify2_report_0): tears already stream down Polly's cheeks from f121 (beat 121-131 omits them and beat 131-151 says tears well up only then); f131-151 she clasps her flippers at her chest and then holds one to her cheek with the other raised, crying with her beak open

spans.view: with the bin inside the open cabinet beside him

beats.text: Pax stands with his flippers out at his sides, blushing and looking ahead with wide eyes
Pax closes his eyes and clasps his flippers together under his beak with a gentle smile
Pax bows forward with his flippers still clasped and his eyes closed

spans.notes: exactly 21 frames; compare 151/171: counter edges black | verification pass 2 (verify2_report_0): beat 151-157 says wide eyes; Pax's eyes close at f154 (open only f151-153); blush marks on Pax's cheeks f151-153 not in effects

spans.view: with the spectators' heads filling the bottom of the picture

beats.text: Pax throws his flippers up on the podium's top step, eyes closed and beaming, while Polly carries a gold trophy in from the left
Pax covers his beak with his flippers, then hugs them to his chest with his eyes closed, while Polly holds up the trophy
Polly hops up onto the top step beside Pax, holding the trophy out in front of her
Polly holds the trophy out to Pax as he reaches for it with his eyes closed
Pax opens his eyes and holds the trophy together with Polly, looking down at it

spans.notes: compare 172/221: podium edges black; the crowd heads bob slightly. Polly is only partly in view at the left edge at f172-188. Crowd is clearly not a lookalike (seen from behind, grey/tan/dark red/sage) | verification pass 2 (verify3_report_1): Beat 194-204 says Pax 'lowers his flippers and smiles down at Polly'. In fact he covers his beak with both flippers (f194-195), then hugs them to his chest with his eyes closed, not looking at her.; Beat 204-222 says Polly 'leans in'; she hops up from the second step onto the top step beside Pax (f203-207, in the air with a shadow below).; Beat 204-222 keeps Pax's eyes closed to the end; he opens

spans.view: with the large number one step of the podium under him

beats.text: Pax takes the gold trophy from a flipper reaching in from the left
Pax holds the trophy up with both flippers and gazes at it wide-eyed as confetti begins to fall
Pax closes his eyes and wipes away tears with one flipper, holding the trophy with the other while confetti rains down
Pax hugs the trophy to his chest with an open-beaked smile and blushing cheeks as the confetti keeps falling

spans.notes: compare 222/277: podium edges black (the global estimator is confused here by Pax and the confetti, the podium itself does not move). Polly is only a flipper at the left edge f222-226, so she is not listed. Confetti is in-world (falls in the scene), treated as an in-style effect, not an overlay
